verdict.rationale: YYLO is a command-line orchestrator for coding agents, so remote human approval of agent decisions is a fair question for it. The pack documents no phone or mobile approval flow and no approval gate that lets agents keep working. The Slack/GitHub integration only brings messages into kanban and returns completed responses, and Ledger views are local and expose no mutation API; neither is an approval capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working
